title: ariocarpus retusus subsp. trigonus
intro: Ariocarpus retusus subsp. trigonus, commonly known as the trigonus ariocarpus, is a subspecies of cactus belonging to the family Cactaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Ariocarpus retusus subsp. trigonus include wound healing, antimicrobial activity, and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
